messages:
Alex W: Quick thought — can we shrink weekly triage to 30m and move to Tue 11:00am PT? Current 45m Thu is often low attendance. Proposal: 30m, strict timebox, rotating owner. Also suggest alternating RFC/deep-review weeks. Thoughts? :calendar:

Maria P: Tue 11 is hard for me (weekly infra sync). Can we do 11:30 or 12:00? I can try to move my sync but want to flag the conflict.

Devon H: 11:00 works on my side. 30m sounds good if we aggressively prioritize. Suggested slotting:
```
- 5m hotfixes/alerts
- 10m bug queue (top flow-impacting items)
- 10m owners round (who's blocking what)
- 5m blockers + action items
```

Samir: If we cut to 30m we need pre-triage hygiene: owners drop top-3 tickets in the thread by Mon 12:00. triage-bot can nudge. Also propose rotating owner who runs the meeting and posts notes.

triage-bot: Reminder set — weekly triage thread will be generated every Mon 09:00. Current backlog snapshot: open bugs: 142, P0: 2, P1: 18. Will ping owners Mon 09:00 and again Mon 12:00 if no posts.

Emily R: Alternating RFC weeks is 👍. On RFC weeks allocate 15m for one focused RFC + 5m quick sync. For deep reviews we can do async docs and only surface blockers in the call.

Alex W: Cool. Draft action items:
- Move meeting to Tue 11:00 PT starting next week unless objections by EOD Fri.
- Owners post top-3 items by Mon 12:00 (triage-bot reminder).
- Rotate triage owner weekly; owner publishes 1-line note + follow-up tags.
I'll update the calendar and post an agenda template here tomorrow.

Maria P: I'll try to move my infra sync. If I can't, I'll flag by EOD. If several folks object we can shift to 11:30.

Devon H: I'll add a small cron that will collect owners' top-3 and compile a short digest for the meeting. Should reduce prep overhead.

Samir: Suggestion: fallback rule — if owner absent, temporarily assign to the oncall or next-week owner. @oncall — ok to auto-assign?

Emily R: +1 to fallback. Also add a "follow-ups" label so we can query tickets after the meeting. Keeps next-steps clear.

Alex W: Noted both. I'll wire triage-bot to add the follow-ups tag when owner marks an action. Will publish final agenda template + rotation roster tomorrow and send calendar update. Thanks all :thumbsup:

triage-bot: Tentative calendar update queued for review. Will finalize after EOD Fri if no objections.
